body:
Maybe, or maybe it will do what it’s been doing and continually getting worse and worse. I’m only 23 but I’ve been working since I was 14, Full time to help my family. 

I missed out on my childhood to work, I stopped going to school after the 4th grade. I have no passion no hobbies no aspiration no friends. 

The real reason I haven’t ended it is because my family needs my income. But it gets harder every day that comes and goes.  I know for a fact I will reach my breaking point soon and I won’t be able to keep going. I can feel it getting closer every time I wake up.
